_: DM strategies the app can split-test. Activate them in outreach.config.json -> active_strategies. Placeholders are documented in strategies/README.md. A strategy with needs_opener only goes to leads with Instagram, because the opener comes from their posts.

placeholders.greeting: "Hey {first_name}," when the owner's first name is known, otherwise "Hey,"
placeholders.first_name: owner's first name from the website, may be empty
placeholders.neighbour_town: manual override if set, otherwise the nearest other town at least 2 km away
placeholders.towns: "{town} and {neighbour_town}", or just "{town}" when there is no distinct neighbour
placeholders.competitor_clause: "so you can get past {competitor}" (the business with the most reviews in the same town, else region), otherwise "so you rank higher on Google"
placeholders.opener: the one personal line about a recent post, written by the dm-opener skill or by hand
placeholders.trade: what the business does in plain words, defaults to the niche keyword in plural

strategies.name: Area question
strategies.summary: A one-line, no-pitch question about a neighbouring town. Almost everyone answers it, and the answer opens the conversation where you make the offer.
strategies.follow_up: When they reply: thank them, then make the offer in your own words. Example: "Nice. I had a look at how you show up on Google in {towns} and put together a few fixes for your profile. Want me to send them over?"

strategies.name: Personal opener + done-for-you offer
strategies.summary: One personal line about a recent post, then a concrete offer that is already done and costs them nothing to accept.
strategies.template:
{greeting} {opener}

I checked your visibility in {towns} and optimised your Google profile {competitor_clause}. You only need to copy it. My promise: {offer_promise}. Can I send you the profile?
strategies.follow_up: When they say yes: send the finished profile text or a short Loom walking through it. Never ask for a call before they have seen the work.

strategies.name: Post comment + permission question
strategies.summary: A comment on their post, then a question asking permission to share what you noticed. The finding itself is held back for the second message, so the first one costs them nothing.
strategies.template: {opener} had a look at your google listing while i was there, want the two things i'd change?
strategies.follow_up: When they reply: send the two concrete findings (for example missing categories, hours that differ from the website, a competitor above them). Keep it to two.

strategies.name: Post comment + upfront audit offer
strategies.summary: A comment on their post, then a short offer of free upfront work for their trade.
strategies.template: {greeting} {opener} i help {trade} get found online. cool if i send you your google profile, website and seo fixes upfront?
strategies.follow_up: When they say yes: deliver the fixes as a short document or Loom, then ask whether they want help putting them live.
